_comment: Per-camera detection rules. The worker matches a recording's FILENAME
against each rule's glob pattern, in order, and uses the FIRST match.
'default' applies to anything that matches no rule.
Because rules are evaluated top-down, put specific patterns above
general ones (Camera32-* before Camera3*).
Per-rule keys (all optional except 'classes'):
classes    - list of COCO class names to keep. [] means skip the file
entirely (useful for cameras you don't want analyzed).
conf       - confidence threshold override (default 0.45). Raise for
busy scenes with false positives, lower to catch more.
min_area   - motion-gate threshold in px^2 (default 1500). Raise for
outdoor cameras where trees/rain trigger constant motion.
interval   - seconds between sampled frames (default 2.0). Lower for
cameras watching fast movement (driveways, doors).
stationary_frac  - how far an object may travel and still count as
parked, as a fraction of its own box size (default 0.25).
stationary_growth - how much its box may change size and still count
as parked (default 0.35); catches motion towards or away
from the camera, which travel alone cannot see. Raise
either if a camera reports parked objects as moving.
gpu_interval - interval to use instead when the worker has a CUDA GPU,
for cameras where sub-GOP sampling matters (driveways,
doors). Costs a full decode of the file (~10x the
keyframe-only path), so opt in per camera, not globally.
Useful COCO classes: person, bicycle, car, motorcycle, bus, truck,
cat, dog, bird, backpack, handbag, suitcase.
Edit freely - it's re-read on every worker invocation, so changes take
effect on the next file processed. No restart needed.

rules.note: lot cameras - vehicles and people, less twitchy
